hero.title: Income management that preserves capital
hero.subtitle: Australian fixed income for investors who want steady income without putting their capital in harm's way. Public funds, wholesale portfolios and private mandates, run with the same discipline for over three decades.

cards.title: Fixed Income Fund
cards.subtitle: Australian sovereign and senior bank bonds, managed for income and capital stability.

cards.title: Preferred Income Fund
cards.subtitle: Australian government and corporate credit, managed for higher income than cash and traditional fixed interest.

leftRight.title: How we invest
leftRight.body: We are an absolute return manager: benchmark unaware, varying duration at different points in the economic cycle. We don’t take a performance fee, so we are capital preservation focused. The investment universe for all our funds is Australian issuers only in AUD, with no leverage, directly or through derivatives.

leftRight.title: Independent oversight
leftRight.body: We don’t own the funds or administer them like other fund managers. The funds are monitored for mandate compliance by DDH Graham ($17bn FUM) and valued by SS&C. There are 4 eyes on every transaction: Custody - Administration - Investment Management and the Responsible Entity.
